description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 13.03.2017 to 19.03.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically modifying how financial calculations are performed under existing customs law. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations.
